node.statement: Lefschetz value under the singleton hypothesis. Apply lem-topology-lefschetz-hopf to the finite-polyhedron model of breve-sigma using node 1.6. Since the only fixed point is breve-e and its local index is +1, the Lefschetz number is L(breve-sigma)=1. The local-index value is also consistent with lem-topology-local-index-sign and the determinant data supplied by lem-stage1-bound-quotient-index-data.
